> A one handed keyboard for gaming ( Valorant ). It has per-key RGB and is unlike some of my other projects, it is not battery powered, to save money. It is a mechanical keyboard with KMK and circuit python. I will be using quite a few left over / extra parts from week 4 so they will not be included in the BOM ( capacitors, resistors, level shifter ) and neither will the switches because I will buy them myself.
